method: Equal weight across eight variables. Counts come from topic-coverage-after-elite-push.json. A Hard label is not treated as 3-5x difficulty. The difficulty rubric median on active items is 6 out of 18, including items labeled Hard. No variable is scored from intention.

difficultyRubric.scale: 0 to 18 from steps, abstraction, hidden setup, concept mixing, a default distractor point, graph language, passage length, choice length, and time pressure
difficultyRubric.conclusion: The rubric does not show a 3-5x harder bank. Most Hard labels still score like medium items.

evidence.nearDuplicateReduction: Families over the 2-copy cap fell from 978 to 40. Largest family fell from 85 to 11. The 40 remaining families are protected strict-exam items.
evidence.preambleRepair: 106 mismatched scene lines were removed. 501 could not be removed because the repaired text would duplicate an existing fingerprint.
evidence.actScienceForm: Exam 41 exists, 40/40, all referenced questions active.
evidence.tutoring: Lesson stages now end with a check the student can answer. The lesson prompt orders the five problems easy, medium, hard, very hard, and a final challenge. This does not by itself make the practice pool 3-5x harder.

whyNot100: Cutting repeated frames lowered the counts that had been holding coverage, validation share, and graphic totals up. The strict SAT and ACT forms still fill, and a 40-question science form now exists, but the remaining bank is not deep enough, not validated enough, and not hard enough on the rubric to score 95 on any variable.
